features.quote: Turn cap: 20 turns. Past ~20 you're paying for tokens to observe an already-decided outcome.
features.justification_quote: Past ~20 you're paying for tokens to observe an already-decided outcome.

features.quote: Early-terminate runs once degradation onset is firmly detected if you only need onset turn

features.quote: Allow a 'give up / report blocker' action as a first-class tool. The model must be able to terminate by declaring the task blocked.
features.justification_quote: you've engineered the spiral rather than measured the model's tendency toward it. You want to know whether the model chooses to stop appropriately.
